Research internship on generating and selecting data to assess runtime monitors for neural networks, using runway detection during landing as an aviation case study. Work builds on LARD and Lardon-x at ANITI and LAAS-CNRS. Requires Master’s-level computer science/AI and Python. Submit CV, cover letter and transcripts for the last two academic years through the application link on the source page. Supervisor: Jérémie Guiochet. No closing date is stated.
